page.layout: One printed title page, centred: title lines at top, an oval emblem engraving in the middle with a motto around its frame, imprint and date below. Handwritten annotations in the right margin are not printed text and are not transcribed.
page.notes: The emblem engraving sits in the centre of the page: an oval frame inscribed "IN NOCTE" at upper left and "CONSILIUM" at upper right, with an eagle, a crowned figure, serpents and foliage inside, and a mask at the base. The word GENEVÆ is struck through with a dark ink mark, so it is given as legible but partly obscured. The handwritten notes in the right margin (a page reference, a Latin phrase and a signature-like mark) are manuscript and are omitted.
